facts.fact: DH Arab, reporting the Ministry of Health's own account, says 99 healthcare facilities are at various stages of implementing electronic medical records; no denominator and no tier is given, so the number of primary clinics among them is not stated, and the figure is undated (document published 25 September 2026).

systems.tiers: 99 healthcare facilities at various stages of implementation; tiers not stated
citizen-facing platform being prepared for launch: care pathways, appointments, access to health records, children's health information; not live

note: The 99-facility figure is a count of facilities of unstated tier, implementing rather than using; recorded as not-published for primary clinics rather than count:99. The parent may prefer another aspect.
